goal: Replace Chickenbro's generic fallback for time-sensitive player questions with a general semantic QuestionFrame, deterministic evidence-needs planning, a bounded official current-source capability and de-identified planning traces.
userValue: Players can ask a natural question in their own vocabulary and receive an evidence-led answer path: confirmed current facts are cited, while missing comparative evidence remains visibly incomplete instead of becoming a fabricated strength verdict.
scope: semantic QuestionFrame for player vocabulary, product phase, patch and evidence needs
registry-published official Blizzard current-source capability with bounded in-memory collection
evidence-aware answer constraints and de-identified Trace v3
immutable Registry release migration 0026 and candidate/live verification
outOfScope: case-specific or fixed answers for NQ, any class or any patch
arbitrary browser, URL, code, credential, SQL or shell access for the model
comparative ranking corpus, CapabilityGap persistence, Toolsmith, shadow, canary or promotion
frontend layout or public response-schema changes
nonGoals: Do not treat an official patch-change fact as proof of a T0/T1 ranking, DPS, percentile, BiS or personal performance conclusion.
Do not allow a client, model or manifest to choose an implementation, source URL, owner or credential.
Do not start syncs, backfills or scheduled collectors during candidate or live deployment.

mustChange: Normalize player phrasing into a safe QuestionFrame before capability discovery.
Select only an immutable Registry capability whose declared evidence needs match the frame.
Return only bounded official facts, source references, status and limitations to answer composition.
Record de-identified selected and unmet evidence types in Trace v3.
mustNotChange: Existing Raider.IO and Warcraft Logs capability identities and their guarded adapter paths remain available.
Personal templates and SimC remain bounded context evidence, not registry Tools.
Raw chat, prompts, answer text, source bodies, credentials, WCL identity and arbitrary URLs remain out of traces and adapter inputs.
A partial, failed, stale or unmatched official source never becomes a comparative strength claim.
riskUnknown: Official current pages may lack an exact class/spec/PTR match; that is a literal partial evidence result, not a model-failure substitute.

Candidate database active-pointer promotion temporarily requires compatible runtime code on both candidate and live service; deployment must minimise that window and retain the v1 pointer rollback value.
evidenceRequired: QuestionFrame, current-source, Registry/runtime, Trace/Eval and affected backend regressions.
Clean candidate-head full Harness and local CR against the source and owner boundaries.
Transactional migration, registry identity, file parity, generic/PTR/WCL/Raider.IO smoke, timer/backflow state and rollback pointer proof.
User acceptance of the real WeChat natural-language PTR question flow after self-test handoff.

ownership.factOwner: server/chickenbro_question_frame.py owns semantic normalization; server/chickenbro_registry.py owns immutable eligibility; server/chickenbro_current_sources.py owns bounded official facts; server/news_backend.py only orchestrates their safe projections; server/chickenbro_observability.py owns Trace v3.

engineeringHealth.reason: The existing HTTP hotspot only composes pure semantic, registry, adapter and trace owners; the new source adapter accepts a finite projection and source allowlist rather than arbitrary model-selected retrieval.

acceptanceEvidence: Equivalent player slang resolves into a canonical class/spec/phase frame without answer text or fixed per-question response.
A matching official current source produces a cited fact; no comparison evidence produces an explicit limitation and blocks strength/ranking language.
Existing community-build and WCL selections retain their v1 capability identity.
Candidate and live deployment prove migration/pointer identity, file parity, health, generic/PTR/WCL/Raider.IO paths, trace redaction and no new timer backflow.
The user verifies the real WeChat PTR question path and explicitly accepts it.

decisionLog.decision: The user approved a general smarter player-question chain, explicitly rejecting fixed Q&A or case-by-case hardcoding.
The user authorized bounded synchronous current-source reads, deployment, self-test and subsequent handoff for user acceptance.
